subject: No-learn confirmation, cross-border evidence, and contract redline status
messages:
From: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helixhealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: confirmation of ‘no-learn’ + cross-border evidence for procurement hold

Hi Jasmine,

We’re at final procurement review for the Helix integration and a couple of items are blocking our Security & Privacy committee:

1) A firm written confirmation that Helix customer data will not be used to improve Redwood models (no-training / no-learn commitment), including whether any aggregated telemetry could be used.
2) Operational evidence showing how data is isolated and any cross-border transfer controls (logs, KMS residency, subprocessor list).
3) A redlined DPA with explicit carveouts for model-improvement exclusions and exportability of tenant data; our legal team needs an ETA for the redlines.

Procurement has paused the deal pending those items; can you share the requested artifacts and timeline? If you can provide a named contact on your side who can sign an operational statement, that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Anya Patel
Head of Security Programs
Helix Health

--

Hi Anya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for; high-level answers below and we’ll follow up with artifacts by EOD tomorrow (internal legal/ops are looped).

- No-learning commitment: Redwood will not use Helix customer content to improve open or internal models that are trained for general improvements. We can provide a signed one-page operational statement that names the contact for signing.

- Cross-border evidence & controls: we have onshore KMS options, subprocessor inventory exports, and audit traces for routing. We’ll gather a short evidence pack (PDFs) that maps the controls to your checklist.

- Redline ETA: our legal team can deliver a marked-up DPA within 48 hours; if you send any required language, we’ll prioritize it.

Next steps: Ben (legal) will produce the redline and the one-page operational statement; David (privacy/ops) will pull the subprocessor export and a short operations playbook showing routing and KMS options. Marissa (AE) — I’ve put you on the thread to keep procurement aligned on timing.

Would you prefer the evidence pack uploaded to a shared Drive link or sent as attachments on email?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Anya — apologies for the procurement pause; thank you for the clear list. Per our conversation below, please find the initial artifacts attached and summarized here:

1) No-Learn commitment (attached: helix_no_learn_stmt.pdf) — Redwood confirms we will not use Helix customer content to train or improve our model weights or production model training pipelines. We will not incorporate raw customer prompt/response pairs into model training datasets. Aggregated telemetry used purely for service performance (e.g., latency histograms, system metrics) is collected in anonymized form and is not used to change model behavior.

2) Evidence pack (attached: redwood_operational_playbook_v1.pdf) — includes: subprocessor inventory (current snapshot), KMS residency options, a routing diagram showing US-only tenancy options, and an explanation of runtime no-learn enforcement (how the no-learn flag bypasses model improvement paths and blocks data export into training pipelines).

3) Redlined DPA (attached: contract_redline_v2.docx) — initial redline from Redwood legal that includes specific carveouts for model-improvement exclusions and a clause for tenant-data exportability. If Helix wants any changes, send the preferred language and we’ll incorporate. We’ve also prepared a DocuSign flow for acceptance: https://app.docusign.com/redwood/HLX-2026-0923

4) Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether you prefer the artifacts on Drive or as email attachments (we attached PDFs here).
- If procurement needs a named signatory for the No-Learn statement, I can sign on behalf of Redwood Legal or we can arrange an operations attestation from David.

Attachments: helix_no_learn_stmt.pdf, redwood_operational_playbook_v1.pdf, contract_redline_v2.docx

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
